text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I took a brief look, and it's not bad 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's form is beautiful too. You 
observe things quite thoroughly, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Please continue guiding your Umamusume 
without letting your guard down. Farewell.
